outcome: hypertensive disorder of pregnancy (gestational hypertension, preeclampsia, HELLP syndrome)
cohort: Singleton pregnancies with preexisting diabetes mellitus who had a dosage of the sFlt-1/PlGF ratio between 30 and 34+6 weeks of gestation were included.
finding: The sFlt-1/PlGF ratio demonstrated good predictive value for preeclampsia in women with preexisting diabetes mellitus, with an AUC of 0.90, suggesting its utility as a prognostic tool during the third trimester.
gest_age: sFlt-1/PlGF ratio measured between 30 and 34+6 weeks of gestation
